The main takeaway from our work is that

the preoptic area is the major source of LHRH in the sheep brain, and that this area has a relatively simple and direct projection to the median eminence, which is consistent with a major role in the control of the reproductive cycle.
the distribution of LHRH‐containing cells and fibers in the sheep brain appears to be very similar to that in other species, such as the rat, monkey and human.
